path_field_behavior_boundary: summary, diagnostics, manifest, IR, object, and runtime metadata paths are provenance until parser, sema, lowering, IR, runtime, or e2e owners claim behavior
fail_closed_reasons: compile status does not match result.status
successful compile did not set result.success
successful compile published a result-owned error message
successful compile published a context last_error
failing compile published no result-owned error message
result-owned error message is present but empty
result-owned error_message snapshot differs from accessor text
context last_error and result-owned error_message differ
artifact path is present but empty
artifact path presence disagrees with result_has_artifact
frontend C API accessor contract fail-closed
fail_closed_behavior_boundary: status mismatch, result success mismatch, missing result-owned error messages, empty artifact paths, missing artifacts, diagnostics path failures, accessor failures, fallback, shim, old-mode, compatibility, and report-only claims are canonical rejection or strict-error evidence
ownership_expectations: compile result storage is caller-owned and destroyed through objc3c_frontend_c_result_destroy
result-owned error strings are reported separately from context last_error and must match on failures
artifact path access is mediated by objc3c_frontend_c_result_has_artifact and borrowed views of result-owned path strings
runner-required artifacts are explicit per emitted option and compile status
all five stage summaries are checked through objc3c_frontend_c_stage_summary_is_well_formed before summary publication
